title: SITKA in 25 seconds: the open-source exoskeleton you can sit on (promo-mode test cut)
description:
A 25 second test cut made end to end by Story Forge's promo mode from the Sitka CAD.

GitHub: https://github.com/nicedreamzapp/sitka

All visuals are rendered from the real Sitka CAD (Blender). Music: original instrumental made with Song Forge.
